panel.title: Voice Channel Connection
panel.subtitle: Connect the external bridge here. No manual entry calls are needed.
panel.automatic_name: The name follows the host character settings and updates automatically.
panel.start_plugin: Panel service is starting. Start the plugin process if it remains unavailable.
panel.check_connection: Check the EXE, connection code and host speech settings.
panel.pair_help: In the EXE, click Copy connection code. Paste it below and connect. Future EXE launches reconnect automatically.
panel.private: The local authentication code is stored without being echoed. Model credentials remain in N.E.K.O.
entries.ui_only: Invoked by the connection panel; manual entry calls are not required.
errors.pair: Connection failed. Start the EXE, copy its current code and configure the host character.
errors.control: Action failed. Check the connection and join a voice channel in the EXE.
panel.empty_code: Paste a connection link from the EXE first.
panel.unavailable: The panel is not ready. Refresh it and make sure the plugin is running.
panel.transport: Local HTTP over TCP, default http://127.0.0.1:18765. Do not use the host ZeroMQ address.
panel.speech_error_connected: Bridge connected; host speech failed. Pairing is not required.
panel.host_voice_note: Channel playback requires the current character name shown above. This is a bridge rule, not a host requirement. Free voice shares the host session, memory and tools; other speech still enters the host. 可在 EXE 的“仅回应称呼”开关关闭过滤。
panel.host_voice_identity: Each channel turn carries its display name. Replies to other members should begin with their name; the human profile keeps its own form of address. Context delivery needs live multi-user verification; host memory remains shared.
panel.error.NEKO_HOST_AUDIO_FORMAT_UNSUP: This host voice emits compressed audio. This integration supports PCM; try the default host voice.
panel.error.NEKO_HOST_NO_TRANSCRIPT: Audio sent; no host transcript received.
panel.error.NEKO_HOST_NO_REPLY: Transcript received; no host reply received.
panel.error.NEKO_HOST_NO_REPLY_AUDIO: Reply text received; no audio received.
panel.error.NEKO_HOST_AUDIO_INCOMPLETE: Partial audio received without audio completion.
panel.error.NEKO_HOST_TURN_NOT_FINISHED: Audio completed; the host turn has not finished.
panel.cable_ready: 输出线路：虚拟音频线已就绪（收集整句后发送）
panel.cable_wait: 输出线路：虚拟音频线未就绪，请在 EXE 中选择并启用 CABLE Output
panel.websocket_output: 输出线路：插件回复音频
panel.wake_disabled: 称呼过滤已关闭：无需叫名字即可回应频道发言；仍检查音轨来源和静音。可在 EXE 的“仅回应称呼”开关重新开启。免费语音仍共用本体会话。
guide.download_title: Getting started · Download the voice bridge
guide.download_button: Download Windows voice bridge EXE (GitHub Releases)
guide.download_help: This plugin needs the separate voice bridge app. Open the download page, expand Assets, and download NekoVoiceBridge-Setup-…-x64.exe. Install and launch it; Python and Node.js are not required.
guide.download_match: Choose a version compatible with your plugin and read its release notes. Install the EXE and .neko-plugin separately. GitHub Source code downloads are not installers.
guide.connect_step: Copy the connection link from the EXE and save it in the connection panel below. Follow the EXE setup wizard to sign into KOOK, join a voice channel, and test audio.
